releaseNotes: Expands passage commentary from 137 to 152 entries and closes the remaining canonical-book gaps so the commentary library covers all 66 Bible books. New entries add context, observation, interpretive safeguards and linked cross-references for Psalms, Job, Chronicles, Song of Solomon, Lamentations, Obadiah, Jonah, Nahum, Zephaniah, Haggai, Malachi, 2 John, 3 John and Jude. Refreshes offline cache and verifies references against the bundled KJV.
